parameters.query: UPDATE gov.missions SET approval_state='approved', approved_by='{{$json.owner_id_sql}}', approved_at=now(), approval_note='{{$json.note_sql}}' WHERE mission_id='{{$json.mission_id_sql}}' AND approval_state='awaiting_owner_ack' RETURNING mission_id, approval_state;

UPDATE gov.mission_runs SET status='queued', phase='owner_approved', updated_at=now(), last_error_code=NULL, last_error_excerpt_256=NULL WHERE mission_id='{{$node['Validar Ack do Owner'].json.mission_id_sql}}' AND status IN ('awaiting_owner_ack','queued','blocked') RETURNING run_id, mission_id, status, phase;

UPDATE gov.missions SET approval_state='denied', approved_by='{{$json.owner_id_sql}}', approved_at=now(), approval_note='{{$json.note_sql}}' WHERE mission_id='{{$json.mission_id_sql}}' AND approval_state='awaiting_owner_ack' RETURNING mission_id, approval_state;

UPDATE gov.mission_runs SET status='blocked', phase='owner_denied', updated_at=now(), last_error_code='OWNER_DENIED', last_error_excerpt_256=LEFT('mission denied by owner', 256) WHERE mission_id='{{$node['Validar Ack do Owner'].json.mission_id_sql}}' AND status IN ('awaiting_owner_ack','queued','running') RETURNING run_id, mission_id, status, phase;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status:'ok', mission_id:($node['Validar Ack do Owner'].json.mission_id || null), next_action: ($node['Validar Ack do Owner'].json.decision === 'approve' ? 'dispatch_auto' : 'mission_blocked') } }}
